title: Ai renditions based on my memories of dreams.
content: I often have recurring dreams and here are a few of them that I described to AI to get images close to what I remember them to look like, obviously they won’t be exactly as I remember them or as I imagine them, but these are fairly close to what I have seen and once I heard about this mall world thing, I fully believe that that’s where these take place I believe that these places are connected. The first image is that of one of my earliest dreams that I remember from when I was about three or four. for some reason, I was picked up by this woman in this like old vintage town car and I was taken to the mayors office and I was sat down across from this woman, and she was sitting there talking to me and I could hear this loud pen clicking in the distance, and it was almost as if I was the only one who could hear it, but for some reason it was terrifying. The second image is a recurring dream that I have after I was in a car accident. Oddly enough, the accident happened during the summer so it’s weird that I always have this stream during winter time but it’s usually me driving and no matter how hard I push the gas. I can’t go faster and no matter how hard I push the brakes. I can’t really ever come to a complete stop I drive endlessly and somehow I always end up being hit by another car and like rolling and then I wake up.my accident was my CV joint going and me hitting a tree so it’s not even a memory of my accident or anything like that. It’s something completely different. The third image is something that I dream about often. In this, I am always with a group of people usually ones that I don’t know in real life, but I seem to know who they are in the context of the dream. we are hopping from beam to beam because they’re almost spaced too far apart across this cliff at some parts we have to shimmy across a ledge and then other parts have these like crude wooden steps shoved into the side of the cliff there is a road that kind of breaks off at the end of the cliff and there are a broken down cars on it and we’re trying to get to that road to get back to civilization but as we’re trying to make our way across this walkway, there is a giant whale that keeps jumping up that is eating people. The fourth picture is a kind of amusement park/fair that I always end up in. There is a very long line at the beginning like I mean it is amaze of lines that you have to go through and you go through gift shops that are part of the line before you get in and you walk into all of these like food carts and then when you keep walking, it turns into kind of like a state fair vibe there’s those kinds of rides and like more food cart set up it’s not quite as fancy as most amusement parks I’ve been to it gives more of like a thrown up and taken down kind of vibe, but there are large like buildings with kind of stages like for shows, though I’ve never been to them. The fifth image is of a room that I have woken up and repeatedly and it’s in this kind of giant mansion I guess is the vibe that I get I’ve never been outside of the room, but I’m always locked in this room and I am sometimes with my mom, Sister and Sister‘s best friend,sometimes my sister‘s best friend isn’t there. but every time I’m in this room there is this broken frame on the floor. It seems like it might be some sort of gallery because there are photos everywhere but there is a nail or something or a splinter that has come out of the frame and is lodged into my mom‘s leg and she’s laying on the floor screaming and I am trying to tell my sister and her friend that we need to help Mom and we need to get help and they’re very nonchalant and don’t seem to have any concerns. The last image is of a sort of theme park/waterpark that I have been to multiple times and sometimes it’s a positive experience while others. It’s a negative experience my worst experience while at this park in my dreams was when I was on a very heavy pain medication in the hospital and I was there went on a ride. The ride broke down and I got off and went into the park down this walkway and I got off the ride that goes into the tunnel. Walked out of the tunnel down the walkway and I started being attacked by ferrets, and they started biting me, and they were biting me all over the place. They were hanging from my arms in my legs and my stomach, and they’re hanging on all of my clothes, and I was just being mauled by them basically it was like a huge amount of them coming after me. I ran into the water to try to get away from them and they continued to jump into the water at the beach attacking me, and I had to start drowning them in the water. I woke up sobbing because ferrets are my favorite animal, and it was a very traumatic dream.
